steps.caption: Compose a Google update
steps.narration: Google shows three kinds of post on a listing: an update, an event and an offer. Here is how each one is composed.

steps.caption: Post type
steps.narration: Post type is Standard, Event or Offer.

steps.value: Fall gutter clean-outs are booking now across Denver. Call to reserve a free inspection.
steps.caption: Write the update
steps.narration: A standard update is plain text. Type it in the Post draft box.

steps.caption: 1,500 characters, 10 photos
steps.narration: The counter shows how much of the fifteen hundred characters is used, and the first ten ticked photos are attached.

steps.caption: Call to action
steps.narration: Call to action adds a button: Book, Order, Shop, Learn more, Sign up or Call.

steps.caption: Learn more
steps.narration: Choose Learn more, and the button needs an address.

steps.caption: Action URL
steps.narration: Type the Action URL the button opens.

steps.caption: Event
steps.narration: Choose Event, and the post gains a title, a start and an end.

steps.caption: Times are the location's local time
steps.narration: Event and offer times use the Google location's local time.

steps.caption: Offer
steps.narration: Choose Offer for a deal. An offer has no button, and it gains a coupon code.

steps.caption: Coupon code
steps.narration: Type the coupon code, if the offer has one.

steps.caption: Add post to draft batch
steps.narration: Add post to draft batch keeps this post and lets you write the next one.

steps.caption: Approve & queue post
steps.narration: When it reads right, choose Approve and queue post. Nothing reaches Google before that.

steps.caption: Queued at the top
steps.narration: The offer is queued at the top of Calendar, queue and history.

youtube.title: How to write a Google update, event or offer | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: How to compose the three kinds of Google Business Profile post in ConstructHUB: a standard update with a button such as Call or Learn more, an event with a title and times, and an offer with a coupon code. The post is queued only when you approve it.
